intent.question: Which authorized workstations have observed findings, and what evidence should be reviewed?
intent.action: Open the scoped station and inspect its observed findings and source evidence.
intent.scope: Current projected inventory within the atomic overview grant and current workstation read scope.
intent.exclusions: No inferred work duration, file copying or security compliance; missing identity binding is unavailable.
sources: Canonical: workstation inventory, summary and active finding projections.
Supplemental: exact retained PostgreSQL observations and protection snapshots referenced by findings.
intent.freshness_expectation: Projection and source timestamps describe observed freshness; evaluator completeness is unproven.
intent.rights: workstations.overview atomic field grant and workstation read capability, including scoped denies.
intent.coverage: Authorized projected station identities; distinct observed findings do not establish evaluated coverage.
intent.completeness: Not proven: missing or zero observed findings never establish a passed check.
intent.denominator: Distinct authorized projected stations after search, domain and OU filters.
intent.retention: This view reads retained PostgreSQL evidence only; missing evidence is unavailable, with no history substitution.
intent.provenance: Station and finding IDs, rule revision and exact server-owned source references and hashes.
intent.deterministic_policy: Read projected station identities and active findings; missing evaluations remain unknown.
intent.result_limits: 50 stations per page, 100 findings per card and 100 source references per finding; five-second reads.
intent.fallback: Source read errors fail visibly; missing exact retained evidence is not collected. No decisions or source collection.

acceptance_lanes.product_user: Open an authorized projected station, its observed findings and retained source, then return to the list.
acceptance_lanes.authorization: Atomic overview grant and current scoped read admission precede counts, pages, cards and evidence.
acceptance_lanes.deterministic_interpretation: Distinct observed findings are lower bounds; missing evaluations remain unknown.
acceptance_lanes.api_view_model: Registered report data/detail routes use bounded keyset pages and exact source references.
acceptance_lanes.ui_honest_states: Denied, partial, unknown and unavailable source states never become safe zero.
acceptance_lanes.evidence_audit: Exact PostgreSQL source hashes are checked; no mutation or audit guarantee is asserted.

intent.deterministic_policy: Present only native logons observations for server-bound agents; immutable ID orders PG/history pages without inferring activity.
intent.result_limits: At most 500 authorized stations, 90 days and 500 rows per page; continuity is not_proven.
